pages.title: The snow's own
text: The Snow Fields keep a heavy-coated grazer, a long-legged runner and a pale floater, and something with mandibles that crawls out of the snow at night.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with that same reagent. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though none of them has a familiar gift of its own.

pages.title: Driftpelt
text: A round, thick-coated grazer in herds of two to four. **26 health** and **5 armour**, and very slow.
It drops **1 to 3 Drift Pelts**, more with Looting.

pages.title: Frost Strider
text: A tall, quick strider in herds of two to four. **22 health** and **1 armour**.

pages.title: Snowveil
text: A pale floater that drifts over the snow in ones to threes. **12 health**, no armour.

pages.title: Rime Crawler
text: A low, icy crawler that rises on the open snow at night, one to three at a time. It has **23 health** and **3 armour**, and its bite does **4** and poisons you for 3 seconds.
It drops **1 to 2 Rime Mandibles**, a Venom reagent. Rime Mandibles call the Cairn Wight at the Cairn Ring, and the Wight calls Rime Crawlers of its own: see [guardians](guardians).
